label: Chapter 8
name: Recent Developments and Contemporary Issues in Supply Chains

questions.q: Green supply chain management uses environmentally friendly inputs and turns them into outputs that can be:
o: Reclaimed and re-used at the end of their life cycle
questions.d: Green supply chain management is the process of using environmentally friendly inputs and transforming them into outputs that can be reclaimed and re-used at the end of their life cycle, creating a sustainable supply chain.

questions.q: Which statement correctly contrasts SCM and CRM?
o: SCM coordinates the flow of work from vendors to retailers; CRM makes sure customers get support and services, including after sales
SCM handles after-sales service; CRM handles suppliers
CRM reduces inventory; SCM handles customer complaints
questions.d: SCM ensures the business has the materials, information and financial resources to produce on time, coordinating work from vendors to retailers. CRM staff interact with customers so they get support and services, including after sales.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the 7 Rs of logistics?
questions.d: The 7 Rs: right product, right quantity, right condition, right place, right time, right customer and right price.

questions.q: Making sure goods are properly packed and shipped so they reach the customer undamaged relates mainly to:
questions.d: Right condition: the product should reach the customer in good condition; procurement must ensure products are properly packed and shipped.

questions.q: Which R is described as determining the profit or loss a company makes?
questions.d: Right price: pricing is crucial because it determines the profit or loss. Managers analyse industry dynamics and keep a record of costs so goods are sold at the correct price.

questions.q: The Oman Logistics Strategy 2040 aims for the logistics sector to become:
o: The second largest contributor to GDP after hydrocarbons
The third largest employer after tourism
questions.d: The Oman Logistics Strategy 2040 sets the aim for logistics to become the second largest contributor to GDP after hydrocarbons.

questions.q: What was the initial target for the logistics sector's contribution to Oman's GDP by 2020?
questions.d: The initial target was a US$7.8 billion contribution to GDP by 2020, shown by the ambition of Oman's vision for its ports.

questions.q: Oman's 2040 initiative and its Tanfeedh programme cite tourism and logistics as key growth areas mainly to:
o: Diversify the economy away from dependence on diminishing natural resources
questions.d: Both cite tourism and logistics, among a handful of sectors, as key growth areas for diversifying the Sultanate's economy away from dependence on its diminishing natural resource reserves.

questions.q: Which term means using high-level methods and tools to project future trends, events and behaviours from supply chain data?
questions.d: Advanced analytics uses high-level methods and tools to project future trends, events and behaviours based on supply chain data. Supply chain analytics in general means examining raw supply chain data to reach conclusions or make predictions.

questions.q: Which technology creates decentralised, distributed, tamper-proof and unchangeable digital records of transactions?
questions.d: Blockchains create decentralised, distributed and digital records of transactions that are anonymous, tamper-proof and unchangeable.

questions.q: A company turns customer returns and waste into new or refurbished products. This is:
questions.d: A circular supply chain reuses or repurposes waste and customer returns into new or refurbished products, aiming to minimise raw material use and discarded waste.

questions.q: Supply Chain as a Service (SCaaS) means:
o: Outsourcing portions of the supply chain process to a third party
Selling the supply chain to customers
Running the supply chain without any software
questions.d: SCaaS is a relatively new method in which portions of the supply chain process are outsourced to and supported by a third party. It can bring benefits but also significant challenges.

questions.q: Attaching sensors to delivery vehicles to get live tracking updates is an example of:
questions.d: IoT improves supply chain visibility in production and inventory management, and live tracking updates can be gathered by attaching sensors to shipping and delivery vehicles.

questions.q: The supply chain trend 'focused towards customers' includes a move from:
o: Push by the firm to pull by the customer
Pull by the customer to push by the firm
questions.d: Trend (1), focused towards customers: a move from push (by the firm) to pull (by the customer), more personalised, with global coherence and reactivity.

questions.q: Under the 'partnership strategy' trend, which activities are outsourced as 'non-strategic'?
questions.d: Trend (3), partnership strategy: a move from a risk-reduction approach to a balanced relationship, focusing on core competencies, brand, customers and new products, and outsourcing non-strategic activities such as delivery, transport and storage.

questions.q: In the supply chain of the future, the change 'from inventory to information' leads to:
o: Demand-based replenishment and quick response systems
Focus on markets and creation of customer value
Integral management of materials and goods flow
questions.d: SC of the future: functions → processes (integral management of flows); profit → performance (key performance drivers); products → customers (markets and customer value); inventory → information (demand-based replenishment and quick response); transactions → relationships (SC partnerships).

questions.q: Autonomous technology in supply chains is limited to autonomous vehicles.
questions.d: The scope of autonomous technology is much wider than autonomous vehicles; for example, robots that move on their own in warehouse management systems.

questions.q: IoT with 5G enables fast data signals and real-time information sharing in the supply chain.
questions.d: IoT with the help of 5G enables fast data signals and empowers sharing real-time information; a fast wireless network is becoming imperative in the supply chain.

questions.q: The change 'from transactions to relationships' leads to supply chain partnerships.
questions.d: In the SC of the future, moving from transactions to relationships leads to SC partnerships.

questions.q: The partnership strategy trend is a move from a balanced relationship toward a risk-reduction approach.
questions.d: It is the opposite: a move from a risk-reduction approach to a balanced relationship.
